offerings.name: Reader API https://s.jina.ai (Search the web and convert results to LLM-friendly text)
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on token usage; one API key gives access to all search foundation products. Tiers: 10 Million tokens Free (non-commercial use only, CC-BY-NC); 1 Billion tokens $50 ($0.050 / 1M tokens); 11 Billion tokens $500 ($0.045 / 1M tokens). Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens.
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens; 'Toy Experiment' 10 Million tokens — Free, Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.output_type: Returns the top five search results with their URLs and contents, each in clean, LLM-friendly text; JSON response mode returns a list of five entries (URL, title, content, timestamp).
offerings.note: Prepend https://s.jina.ai/?q= to the query. Rate limits: 100 RPM w/o API key, 100 RPM w/ free key, 1000 RPM w/ paid key (RPM+TPM enforced per IP/key). Average latency 2.5s. New token-based pricing model introduced May 6th, 2025; MCP server available at mcp.jina.ai.
